subject: Marine Works - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Vancouver Harbour
Marine operations in Indian Arm in the vicinity of 49 20.058N 122 54.046W. Operations include the deployment, testing and recovery of subsea equipment. 
Hours of operation daily from 1500UTC Nov 18 to 0000UTC Nov 21. 
The vessel ASI Marine Oculus on site monitoring VHF Ch. 16 and 12.
